/*
 Gross\sincome\scredit\spercentage,
 used\sin\sincome\sbase\scalculation.
 */
 
 if\s!is_anniversary\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\s0
 end
 
 if\sPolicy.no_income_growth_after_wd\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\s0
 end
 
 if\spolicy.is_rider_multiplier\sthen
 \s\s\s\sif\svar.is_annexus_5yr\sthen\s
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sif\s!DebugSwitch.lock_in_during_strategy_term\sthen
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sif\scompare(InterestCredit.adjustment_factor_on_activation>0,1E-6)\sthen
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\siif(any_withdrawals_taken,\sInforce.adjusted_multiplier,\sInforce.multiplier)*
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\siif(inforce.is_annexus_accelerator,\sInterestCredit.x5_rider_return,\sInterestCredit.strategy_return)
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s*InterestCredit.adjustment_factor_on_activation
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\selse
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\siif(any_withdrawals_taken,\sInforce.adjusted_multiplier,\sInforce.multiplier)*
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\siif(inforce.is_annexus_accelerator,\sInterestCredit.adjusted_x5_rider_return,\sInterestCredit.adjusted_strategy_return)
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\send
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\selse
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\siif(prev(InterestCredit.lock_in_return)\sand\sInterestCredit.lock_in_return,\s
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s0,
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\siif(any_withdrawals_taken,\sInforce.adjusted_multiplier,\sInforce.multiplier)*
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\siif(inforce.is_annexus_accelerator,\sInterestCredit.x5_rider_return,\sInterestCredit.strategy_return))
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\send
 \s\s\s\selse
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\sInterestCredit.interest_credit_percent_for_liability\s*\s
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\siif(any_withdrawals_taken,\sInforce.adjusted_multiplier,\sInforce.multiplier)
 \s\s\s\send
 else
 \s\s\s\sreturn\sInforce.income_credit_percentage
 \s\s\s\s
 end

/*
 Cash\ssurrender\svalue.
 
 The\sCash\sSurrender\sValue\sis\sthe\samount\sYou\swill\sreceive
 if\sYou\srequest\sa\sfull\ssurrender.
 The\sCash\sSurrender\sValue\sis\sthe\sContract\sValue
 minus\sany\sapplicable\sWithdrawal\sCharges\sand\spremium\staxes,
 subject\sto\sthe\sMinimum\sWithdrawal\sValue\sprovision\sabove.\s
 
 The\sCash\sSurrender\sValue\swill\snever\sbe\sless\sthan\sthe\sMinimum\sWithdrawal\sValue.
 The\sCash\sSurrender\sValue\sthat\smay\sbe\savailable\sunder\sthis\sContract
 is\snot\sless\sthan\sthe\sminimum\sbenefits\s
 required\sby\sthe\sapplicable\slaws\sof\sthe\sstate\sin\swhich\sthis\sContract\sis\sissued.
 */
 
 if\s(IsPiPEffective)\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\s0
 end
 
 if\sInforce.is_annexus_product\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\smax(mwv_post_growth,\sMGW\s-\sWConLapse\s-\sMVAonLapse)
 elif\sInforce.is_mav_product\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\smax(minimum_accumulation_value_post_growth
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s-\smax(minimum_accumulation_value_post_growth\s-\sAvailableFWA,\s0)\s*\sPolicy.wcp[step],
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\saccount_value_post_glb_fee\s-\sWConLapse\s-\sMVAonLapse\s-\sPER)
 else
 \s\s\s\sreturn\sMax(mwv_post_growth,\saccount_value_post_glb_fee\s-\sWConLapse\s-\sMVAonLapse\s-\sPER)
 end

/*

 end
 
 if\spolicy.is_rider_multiplier\sthen

 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sif\s!DebugSwitch.lock_in_during_strategy_term\sthen
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sif\scompare(InterestCredit.adjustment_factor_on_activation>0,1E-6)\sthen
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\siif(any_withdrawals_taken,\sInforce.adjusted_multiplier,\sInforce.multiplier)*
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\siif(inforce.is_annexus_accelerator,\sInterestCredit.x5_rider_return,\sInterestCredit.strategy_return)
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s*InterestCredit.adjustment_factor_on_activation
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\selse
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\siif(any_withdrawals_taken,\sInforce.adjusted_multiplier,\sInforce.multiplier)*
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\siif(inforce.is_annexus_accelerator,\sInterestCredit.adjusted_x5_rider_return,\sInterestCredit.adjusted_strategy_return)
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\send
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\selse
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\siif(prev(InterestCredit.lock_in_return)\sand\sInterestCredit.lock_in_return,\s
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s0,

 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\siif(inforce.is_annexus_accelerator,\sInterestCredit.x5_rider_return,\sInterestCredit.strategy_return))
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\send
 \s\s\s\selse
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\sInterestCredit.interest_credit_percent_for_liability\s*\s
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\siif(any_withdrawals_taken,\sInforce.adjusted_multiplier,\sInforce.multiplier)
 \s\s\s\send
 else
 \s\s\s\sreturn\sInforce.income_credit_percentage

/*
 Cash\ssurrender\svalue.
 
 The\sCash\sSurrender\sValue\sis\sthe\samount\sYou\swill\sreceive
 if\sYou\srequest\sa\sfull\ssurrender.
 The\sCash\sSurrender\sValue\sis\sthe\sContract\sValue
 minus\sany\sapplicable\sWithdrawal\sCharges\sand\spremium\staxes,
 subject\sto\sthe\sMinimum\sWithdrawal\sValue\sprovision\sabove.\s
 
 The\sCash\sSurrender\sValue\swill\snever\sbe\sless\sthan\sthe\sMinimum\sWithdrawal\sValue.
 The\sCash\sSurrender\sValue\sthat\smay\sbe\savailable\sunder\sthis\sContract
 is\snot\sless\sthan\sthe\sminimum\sbenefits\s
 required\sby\sthe\sapplicable\slaws\sof\sthe\sstate\sin\swhich\sthis\sContract\sis\sissued.
 */
 
 if\s(IsPiPEffective)\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\s0
 end
 
 if\sInforce.is_annexus_product\sthen
 \s\s\s\sif\sinforce.is_annexus_accelerator\sand\scompare(RiderFeeCollected=0,\s1E-3)\sthen\s
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\spro_rata_fee\s=\sPolicy.rider_fee\s*\selapsed_term_within_year\s*\sdaily_income_base\s
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s*\sSafeDivide(MGW,\sstrategy_value,\s1)
 \s\s\s\selse
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\spro_rata_fee\s=\s0
 \s\s\s\send
 \s\s\s\sreturn\smax(0,\smax(mwv_post_growth,\sMGW\s-\sWConLapse\s-\sMVAonLapse\s-\spro_rata_fee))
 elif\sInforce.is_mav_product\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\smax(minimum_accumulation_value_post_growth
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s-\smax(minimum_accumulation_value_post_growth\s-\sAvailableFWA,\s0)\s*\sPolicy.wcp[step],
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\saccount_value_post_glb_fee\s-\sWConLapse\s-\sMVAonLapse\s-\sPER)
 else
 \s\s\s\spro_rata_fee\s=\siif(compare(RiderFeeCollected=0,\s1E-3),\sPolicy.rider_fee\s*\selapsed_term_within_year
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s*\sincome_base_step_up,\s0)
 \s\s\s\sreturn\smax(mwv_post_growth,\saccount_value_post_glb_fee\s-\sWConLapse\s-\sMVAonLapse\s-\sPER\s-\spro_rata_fee)
 end

/*
 Amount\sof\sdeath\sbenefit.
 
 That\sdeath\sbenefit\swill\sbe\sthe\sgreater\sof:
 1.\sThe\sContract\sValue,\sincluding\sany\sinterest\scredited
 under\seach\sIndex\sInterest\sAccount\sRider\sattached\sto\sthis\sContract
 and\sany\sinterest\scredited\sto\samounts\sallocated\sto\sthe\sFixed\sInterest\sAccount;\sor
 2.\sThe\sMinimum\sWithdrawal\sValue\sas\sdescribed\sunder\sWITHDRAWAL\sPROVISIONS.
 */
 
 if\s(IsPiPEffective)\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\s0
 end
 
 if\svar.is_annexus\sthen
 \s\s\s\sif\sDebugSwitch.disable_IncomeBaseDeathBenefit\sthen
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\sstrategy_value
 \s\s\s\selif\sinforce.is_annexus_accelerator\sand\scompare_dates(ValuationDate,\sInforce.income_rider_death_benefit_date)\s==\s-1\sthen
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\sstrategy_value
 \s\s\s\selse
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\smax(strategy_value,\sincome_rider_death_benefit/60*DB_Disc_Fac)
 \s\s\s\send
 elif\sInforce.is_mav_product\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\smax(account_value_post_interest_credit\s-\sPER
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s+\siif(credit_interest_now,\s0,\sInterestCredit.interest_credit_amount_pro_rata),
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sminimum_accumulation_value_post_growth)
 else
 \s\s\s\sreturn\smax(account_value_post_interest_credit\s-\sPER
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\s+\siif(credit_interest_now,\s0,\sInterestCredit.interest_credit_amount_pro_rata),\smwv_post_growth)\s\s//MVA\sdoes\snot\sapply\sto\sDB
 end
